$meta.name: helios design tokens
$meta.role: single token source for android, ios and web
distanceFromUpstream: Aliases are resolved to concrete values for both themes; the upstream alias is kept per role so a change upstream can be traced.
Alpha modifiers become an explicit alpha plus an 8-digit ARGB literal.

Functional roles the components need (accent, solar, flow, battery, grid, alert, status, insight, chart, skeleton, focus) are named, because the upstream semantic block only defines background, text and separator.
Layout facts stated in design/DESIGN.md are recorded as numbers.

Contrast is measured, not assumed. Six upstream alias choices could not reach their target and were moved to the nearest upstream step; each such role carries a note. Remaining failures are listed in verify.contrast.failures.

brand.formula: light tints ascend accentLight to accent; dark is the mirrored ramp from the same pair; 500 is the accent in both themes

solar.name: Solar
solar.description: Sunlight, production, peak energy. Warm at low brightness, golden at peak.

flow.name: Flow
flow.description: Healthy energy, self-consumption, home load. Desaturated mint at low, vibrant at high.

grid.name: Grid
grid.description: Grid import = attention; export = abundance. Orange for import, blue for export.

battery.name: Battery
battery.description: Battery SoC. Desaturated mint at low SoC, vibrant at high. Bronze tone for warmth.

alert.name: Alert
alert.description: Faults, connection failures, critical warnings. Warm coral.

neutral.name: Neutral
neutral.description: Carbon backgrounds and bone text. Warm grayscale with no blue cast.

brand.name: Brand
brand.description: Dynamic accent slot for white-labeling. Falls back to Solar when brand is helios.

primary.usage: App canvas. Bone on Paper, carbon on Carbon.

tertiary.usage: Cards and tiles at level-1 elevation.

elevated.usage: Sheets, dialogs and glass above content.

scrim.usage: Modal scrim behind sheets and dialogs.

tertiary.note: The dark ramp has no neutral step between 2.48 and 7.63 contrast on carbon, so secondary and tertiary share neutral.900 in dark. The hierarchy comes from the type role, never from dropping below the 4.5 target.

quaternary.note: Disabled content is exempt from WCAG 1.4.3. The measured ratios (4.25 light, 2.48 dark) are recorded so the value stays legible rather than invisible.

inverse.usage: Text on an inverted surface: bone on the carbon surface, carbon on the bone one.

hairline.usage: 1 dp dividers, card outlines and the material inner stroke.

primary.usage: Primary action and selection fill. Equals solar.500 for the helios brand.

strong.usage: Accent text and icons on the app canvas.

onAccent.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.
onAccent.note: The accent fill is the same colour in both themes, so the on-colour cannot follow the inverting ramp; carbon is used in both because bone-on-accent measures 2.89.

primary.usage: Production fill, trajectories and the live output mark.

strong.usage: Production text and values on the app canvas. DESIGN.md section 9 requires solar.700 and brighter on carbon.
Flow text and values on the app canvas.
Battery text and values on the app canvas.

importPrimary.usage: Grid import fill and trails. Attention hue.

importStrong.usage: Grid import text on the canvas or its container.

exportPrimary.usage: Grid export fill and trails. Abundance hue.

exportStrong.usage: Grid export text on the canvas or its container.

strong.usage: Alert text on the app canvas.

onAlert.usage: Text on an alert fill. Both themes use the light end of the ramp for this fixed fill.

fg.usage: Status pill text and dot: producing.
Status pill text and dot: standby.
Status pill text and dot: curtailed.
Status pill text and dot: night.
Status pill text and dot: fault.
Status pill text and dot: offline.
Status pill text and dot: demo system.

todayMarker.usage: Live marker on the today curve.

chartAxis.note: Axis ticks and the per-point scrub readout.

liveTicker.note: Live kW ticker. Width must not change while digits animate.

limits.heroCapNote: DESIGN.md section 9: the hero number caps at 44 sp at 200 percent text scaling.

usage.level-2: Raised tiles on the hero block.
usage.level-3: Sheets, bottom nav, top bar on scroll.

material.reduceTransparency: solid background.elevated at the same elevation, inner stroke at 0.3 alpha (motion-language section 12)

linear.usage: Indeterminate loaders and the skeleton shimmer only. Springs are the default for every other transition (motion-language section 1).

standard.usage: Opacity cross-fades where a spring cannot be interpolated.

entrance.screenTransform: opacity 0 to 1, scale 0.96 to 1.0, translateX 24 to 0 dp

reduceMotion.spring: instant plus a normal-duration opacity cross-fade
reduceMotion.energyFlow: dots stop, static arrows on each path
reduceMotion.batteryRing: trim over the fast duration, no spring

ios.status: not in this pass; ios/ is untouched

web.status: existing PWA keeps src/index.css and tailwind.config.js; this file is the reference, not yet wired into the build

contrast.method: WCAG 2.1 relative luminance, rounded to 2 decimals
